preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 3000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 1000 for n in [case[0] for case in test_cases])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k1 <= n and 0 <= k2 <= n for n, k1, k2 in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, k1 and k2 are integers between 0 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w <= n and 0 <= b <= n for w, b in wb_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, w and b are integers between 0 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().upper() in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a case-insensitive 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().upper() == 'YES') == (can_place(n, k1, k2, w, b)) for line, (n, k1, k2, w, b) in zip(output_lines, zip(n_list, k1_list, k2_list, w_list, b_list)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if it is possible to place all w white and b black dominoes on the 2xN board given the white cell counts k1 and k2, and 'NO' otherwise.
